name: Modified Noise (Dimension-Reducible)
definition: A noise generation technique that optimizes 3D noise calculation on GPUs by exploiting dimension reducibility, storing 2D noise and z-gradients in textures to minimize texture lookups and allow purely computable noise via on-the-fly hash generation.
summary: Modified Noise is a gradient-based procedural noise function that optimizes 3D GPU computation by decomposing it into independent 2D noise and 1D gradient lookups, enabling efficient real-time volumetric rendering.
